title: From AI experiment to production: how Okta governs context for agents at scale
description:
How Okta governs AI agent context in dbt so every agent answer is consistent and trustworthy. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Pooja Crahen, senior manager of analytics engineering at Okta, explains why building the agent was never the hard part: what it could see and trust was. Okta found context fragmentation, no auditability, and undifferentiated instructions behind inconsistent answers. Its three-layer agent context framework is built in dbt, shipped through normal pull requests, and synced into Agents Schema so any agent with SQL access reads the same governed context.

In this session you'll learn:
• The three-layer context framework Okta built entirely in dbt
• How one merged change fixes a wrong answer for every agent
• How Agents Schema makes governed context available to any AI client

Speaker: Pooja Crahen, senior manager of analytics engineering, Okta

Read more: Context engineering is already possible in your warehouse. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/context-engineering-in-your-warehouse
